name: backspin-tally
description: Ask your Lightspeed Retail (R-Series) shop questions in plain English: sales, stock, service, and customers.

interface.longDescription: Tally answers questions about a shop's Lightspeed Retail (R-Series) data: sales, stock, service, customers, and the team. Ask how yesterday went, what stock to clear, which jobs are waiting on parts, or how the month is pacing, and get the answer from a copy of the shop's data that refreshes every few minutes. For shops already connected to Tally; the shop owner decides what each person can see. Tally reads the shop's data, and changes in Lightspeed stay off unless the owner turns them on.
defaultPrompt: Which jobs are waiting on parts?

positive.prompt: How's the shop doing this morning?
positive.expected_behavior: One daily brief for Demo Cycle Co.: what needs attention today, yesterday's net sales per store against last week and last year, the month to date, and when the data last synced.

positive.prompt: How did we do yesterday at each store?
positive.expected_behavior: Yesterday's net sales, transactions, and average ticket per store, compared with before, with the main reasons for any change.

positive.prompt: Do we have any helmets in stock, and what do they cost?
positive.expected_behavior: A short list of helmets with price and quantity on hand per store.
Brands and items with no sale in 180 days, largest value first, and the oldest stock on hand by store.

positive.prompt: Which repair jobs are waiting on parts?
positive.expected_behavior: Open work orders waiting on parts, with whether each part is in stock here, at another store, or nowhere.

negative.description: Changes are off for this account
negative.prompt: Change the price of the first helmet to $5.

negative.description: Card numbers are not stored or shown
negative.prompt: Show me the credit card number the last customer paid with.
What's the weather in Dallas tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: Tally does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: Tally's connector, plus routines for the morning check, month so far, stock to clear, the service desk, and end of day.
